Also, scrutinize the white neck ring; AI often fails to maintain a clean, continuous band, causing it to bleed into the green head or chestnut breast. Verify if the eye reflection is consistent with a single light source.

The duck features a glossy iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, a chestnut-brown breast, and a greyish body. Its bill is bright yellow with a black tip and nostrils. The background consists of blurred vegetation and earth tones.

To rigorously audit the boundary between the green head, white ring, and body, ensuring there is no color bleeding or topological fusion between these distinct plumage regions.
